description: Use this when the person asks to sign up for or sign in to Andru from here. Send their email. Andru emails them a 6-digit code and an Approve button. If they read you the code, call signup_verify. If they tap Approve, call signup_status with the request_id until it returns your key. They also choose how much you can spend without asking them; it starts at nothing beyond the daily free calls.

agentName.description: Optional: your agent's name. The key is named after it.

email.description: The person's email. The code goes here.

foundVia.description: Optional: how the person or their agent found Andru: moltbook, a2a_directory, mcp_registry (includes Smithery), npm, search, ai_assistant, person or other. Other text is kept as written.

previewId.description: Optional: from preview_company. The read becomes their first ICP.

website.description: Optional: their company website, e.g. acme.com. Andru reads it so its answers are about what they sell.

name: signup_start
title: Start sign-up
